bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
cd "$root"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 61
tmp="$(mktemp /tmp/gace-startless-apply.XXXXXXXX.py)"
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT
chmod 600 "$tmp"
curl -fLsS --max-time 25 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot/9655437b10ecb9063ee596d3901fdb1e8244136e/scripts/repair_repeated_start_existing_posts.py' > "$tmp"
test -s "$tmp" || exit 62
n=0
for topic in 102 104 116 1000 81 92 103 50 51 52;do
 n=$((n+1))
 python3 "$tmp" --mode apply --topic-id "$topic" || exit $((80+n))
done
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 95
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 96
echo ALL_TEN_STARTLESS_ORIGINAL_POST_MARKUP_REPAIRS=VERIFIED
echo ORIGINAL_POST_DELETIONS=NONE
echo USERBOT_SESSION=ACTIVE
